annotation.title_clean: Executive Order 14409: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
annotation.title_en: Executive Order 14409: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President of the United States)
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order of June 2, 2026 directing agencies to strengthen cyber defense of federal systems against threats from advanced AI, create a voluntary AI cybersecurity clearinghouse and framework for early government access to covered frontier models, and prioritize prosecution of AI-enabled cybercrime, while disclaiming any mandatory licensing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Agencies must prioritize cyber defense of National Security Systems, DoW and civilian federal systems within 30 days
Treasury-led voluntary AI cybersecurity clearinghouse for vulnerability scanning and patching with industry
Classified benchmarking to designate 'covered frontier models', determined by NSA Director
Voluntary framework giving government up to 30 days pre-release access to covered frontier models
Explicitly no mandatory licensing or preclearance for AI model release; DOJ to prioritize prosecuting AI-enabled computer crimes
